title: [API] Verify and fix user endpoint payload
description:
Verify and fix user endpoint payload mismatch:

PROBLEM: 
- UI collects: name, phone, email, department
- API expects: username, password, name, role

TASKS:
1. Check Prisma schema for User fields (phone, email, department?)
2. Verify PATCH accepts the fields UI sends
3. Decide: update frontend form or backend API

Priority P1 because other issues depend on this resolution.
notes:
## Resolution
Prisma schema User: id, username, password, name, role, isActive
Backend API: PATCH /users/[id] accepts {name?, password?, role?, isActive?}
Frontend collects: name, phone, email, department

ISSUE: phone, email, department won't persist - backend ignores them.

DECISION: Frontend form will keep phone/email/department for display purposes but won't send to API on create/update. Backend can be extended later if needed.

This issue is resolved - the other FE integration issues can proceed.
close_reason: Backend User model: id, username, password, name, role, isActive. Frontend fields (phone, email, department) won't persist - backend ignores them. For now, frontend keeps these for display but doesn't send to API.
